english.title: Consignee of civil explosives failed to retain authority document or copy for 3 years from completion of transfer
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the consignee of civil explosives, namely **(..SPECIFY EXPLOSIVES..), failed to retain the recipient competent authority document or a copy thereof for a period of 3 years from the completion of the transfer
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 8(6) of the Explosives Regulations 2014 and section 33(1)(c) of, and Schedule 3A to, the Health and Safety at Work Act 1974.
english.pointstoprove:

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.
